cases.title: Doujin Peripherals + Limited Packaging
cases.summary: Doujin creator groups / anime merchandise stores, 50-200 sets limited printing, including stickers / badges / acrylic standees / limited outer packaging boxes. SF Express local + DHL global.
cases.delivery: SF Express local 1-2 days + DHL global 2-4 days

cases.title: Independent Designer Brand Packaging
cases.summary: Local independent design brands (apparel / stationery / home), 100-500 sets full packaging (hang tags + stickers + paper bags + thank you cards). Support small-batch multi-SKU printing strategy.

cases.title: Gallery Exhibition Catalogues
cases.summary: Gallery / artist exhibition catalogue printing, 50-200 copies, focus on color reproduction (95%+) + premium paper (matte coated / fine art paper). Hong Kong local gallery long-term clients.

cases.title: Pet Food Packaging + Labels
cases.summary: Local pet food brands (kibble / canned / treats), food-grade safe ink + FSC certified paper. 100-1000 sets full packaging, SF Express local delivery to pet stores / online stores.
cases.delivery: SF Express local 2-3 days + global DHL 2-4 days

cases.title: Pet Store Brand Materials
cases.summary: Pet stores / pet grooming chains, full brand materials (stickers + posters + hang tags + business cards + coupons), 100-500 sets. For store opening / seasonal promotions.

industries.name_ja: マタニティ & ベビー

cases.title: Maternal & Baby Product Packaging (Food-grade)
cases.summary: Maternal & baby product brands (formula / complementary food / skincare), food-grade ink + safety certification. 100-1000 sets full packaging, SF Express local + cross-border delivery.
cases.delivery: SF Express local 2-3 days + DHL global 2-4 days

cases.title: Maternal & Baby Store Brand Materials + Teaching Tools
cases.summary: Maternal & baby stores / early education centers, full brand materials + teaching tool printing (stickers + posters + exercise books + teaching materials). 100-500 sets.

cases.title: Bubble Tea Brand Packaging
cases.summary: Bubble tea shops / tea beverage brands, 100-1000 sets full materials (cup stickers + sealing film + paper bags + coupons + thank you cards). For new store opening / seasonal limited editions.

cases.title: Tea Gift Boxes + Premium Packaging
cases.summary: Tea brands / mooncake brands, 50-500 sets premium gift boxes (foil + embossing + specialty paper). For Mid-Autumn / Spring Festival / wedding seasons.

cases.title: Coffee Shop Brand Materials
cases.summary: Local coffee shops / coffee bean brands, full brand materials (cup stickers + paper cup sleeves + coffee bean bags + hang tags + posters). 100-500 sets.

cases.title: Restaurant Takeaway Packaging
cases.summary: Restaurants / takeaway shops, 100-2000 sets takeaway packaging (stickers + box stickers + paper bags + thank you cards + menus). For food delivery platforms + dine-in scenarios.
